title: Inkjet PVC ID Cards
description: Inkjet PVC ID cards for in-house badge printing and RFID encoding, suited to employee IDs, visitor cards, event passes and membership programs.
summary: Inkjet PVC ID cards are made for organizations that want to print and personalize RFID cards in-house using compatible inkjet card printers.
The Inkjet ID card is laminated with film which is painted with special material, it allows the end user to directly print by an inkjet printer.
ProudTek inkjet ID card can be sinked into water, and the image on card will remain, just like the regular printed PVC card.

faq.question: What are Inkjet PVC ID Cards commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for organizations that want in-house card printing and quick issuance for staff IDs, visitor badges, membership cards, and short-run credential programs.

faq.question: Which chip, protocol, or frequency options are available for Inkjet PVC ID Cards?
faq.answer: Chip: EM4200, ATA5577, Mifare S50, Mifare S70, Ntag213, Ntag215, Ntag216, Protocol: ISO14443A, ISO14443B, 15693 Frequency: 125khz, 13.56MHZ Read Range: 1 – 5cm(depends on reader)

faq.question: What material or form-factor options are available for Inkjet PVC ID Cards?
faq.answer: Material: PVC Form Factor: Card format compatible with common access-control, ID, or NFC workflows. Color: White
